user_story:
As a user, I want to verify that clicking the 'Click Here' link opens a new window so that I can access the linked content. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the link with text 'Click Here', a new window should open. 
2. The URL of the new window should be 'http://elementalselenium.com/'. 
3. The original page URL should remain as 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/windows'. 
4. The heading 'Opening a new window' should be visible on the page.
